description: This file contains utility functions and conversion routines specific to the D3D9 renderer in the ANGLE project, including functions for converting OpenGL enums to Direct3D enums, generating device capabilities, and initializing features.

methods.name: ConvertComparison
methods.description: Converts an OpenGL comparison enum to a Direct3D comparison function.

methods.name: ConvertColor
methods.description: Converts a gl::ColorF to a D3DCOLOR_RGBA value.

methods.name: ConvertBlendFunc
methods.description: Converts an OpenGL blend function enum to a D3DBLEND value.

methods.name: ConvertBlendOp
methods.description: Converts an OpenGL blend operation enum to a D3DBLENDOP value.

methods.name: ConvertStencilOp
methods.description: Converts an OpenGL stencil operation enum to a D3DSTENCILOP value.

methods.name: ConvertTextureWrap
methods.description: Converts an OpenGL texture wrap mode to a D3DTEXTUREADDRESS.

methods.name: ConvertCullMode
methods.description: Converts OpenGL cull face mode and front face to a D3DCULL mode.

methods.name: ConvertCubeFace
methods.description: Converts a gl::TextureTarget cube face to a D3DCUBEMAP_FACES.

methods.name: ConvertColorMask
methods.description: Creates a D3DCOLORWRITEENABLE mask from boolean red, green, blue, alpha flags.

methods.name: ConvertMagFilter
methods.description: Converts an OpenGL magnification filter enum to a D3DTEXF type, considering anisotropy.

methods.name: ConvertMinFilter
methods.description: Converts an OpenGL minification filter enum to D3DTEXF and D3DTEXF mipmap filter, with bias adjustments.

methods.name: ConvertQueryType
methods.description: Converts a gl::QueryType to a D3DQUERYTYPE.

methods.name: GetMultisampleType
methods.description: Returns a D3DMULTISAMPLE_TYPE based on the number of samples.

methods.name: ComputeBlockSize
methods.description: Calculates the size in bytes of a block for a given D3DFORMAT and dimensions.

methods.name: MakeValidSize
methods.description: Adjusts texture/image size to be valid for the given D3DFORMAT, possibly upsampling.

methods.name: InitializeFeatures
methods.description: Initializes D3D feature flags based on the current platform and device capabilities.

methods.name: GetSamplesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of samples for a given D3DMULTISAMPLE_TYPE.
